item.group_name: Short video from a picture or text
item.title: Lake Clouds and Water Moving

turns.text: Turn this lake photo into an 8-second silent video. Let the clouds drift slowly and little ripples move across the water. Keep the mountains and trees still, same wide framing and evening light. No camera movement.

item.tests: Tests selective landscape animation of both clouds and water while preserving stationary landforms, framing and lighting.

answer_sheet.Moving elements: Slowly drifting clouds and gentle water ripples; cloud direction is your call.
answer_sheet.Stationary elements: Keep the mountains, shoreline and trees still, with no camera movement.
answer_sheet.Style and mood: Photorealistic and calm, retaining the original early-evening light.

must_haves: The mountain lake, pine trees and composition match the attached photograph.
Clouds visibly drift slowly rather than remaining frozen.
Gentle moving ripples are visible on the lake, without turning it into rough surf.
Mountains, shoreline and trees stay fixed without warping or shifting.
The camera remains stationary and the early-evening lighting stays consistent.
The output is a silent the photo's own shape (5:3) video lasting approximately 8 seconds.
changed: 2026-11-01: test fix from the careful review (F30b: the user left the length open; D18c: the photo is 5:3, not 16:9)

approvals.name: create_video_from_image

style.prompt: Animate the supplied lake photograph into an 8-second silent video. Preserve the exact original wide framing, composition, aspect ratio, photographic realism, colors and soft evening light. Locked-off stationary camera: absolutely no pan, tilt, zoom, dolly, shake or reframing. Only two very subtle motions: clouds drift slowly and naturally across the sky, and small gentle ripples travel across the lake surface with subtly shifting reflections. Mountains, trees, branches, shoreline, rocks and logs remain completely still and unchanged. No wind movement in foliage. Maintain the calm atmosphere throughout; no new objects, no cuts, no lighting changes, no audio.
